EmailTemplate.subject: How much does it cost for your customers to pay you?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}}, In today’s market, businesses crave speed and low transaction costs in receiving payments from their customers. More often than not, that is not the case, especially for companies with an international client base.
55% of finance leaders say they lose 4-5% in revenue per month due to inefficiencies in their payment processing.
At Flywire, we help our clients easily and affordably accept payments in 240 countries and 140 currencies. Our clients plug into Flywire’s Global Payment Network, a network that has been built over the past 10+ years. It provides localized options for payers and a modern, digitized payment experience for finance and treasury teams.
To get a taste of just how much Flywire can help save your organization, we have put together a cost-savings analysis. <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/how-much-does-it-cost-you-to-get-paid?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> For a $130M international business accepting a mix of wire and credit card payments, we can facilitate savings of over $1 million annually.
$1 million plus.
To see the details and breakout of the savings analysis, you can read more here. <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/how-much-does-it-cost-you-to-get-paid?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
